claims.summary: The article discusses the structure and declension of Russian numerals from 500 to 900, including nominative, accusative, genitive, and other cases.
The article explains that Russian numerals from 500 to 900 consist of two parts: one related to the numerals five to nine and the other historically related to 'сто' ('hundred').
The article outlines the declension patterns for different cases (genitive, dative, instrumental, prepositional) and how the numerals change in these cases, including examples.
